notes: Fixes the MEBP regression in 3.9.9 - the find pattern was positioned using the nest's centred-bar coordinate against cell-frame bounds, so it was thrown off the steel and every station clamped onto the same limit: markers on only the first window and an X spread squeezed to nothing. Frames reconciled, and the guard that clamped each station independently is now a whole-pattern translate so the spread can no longer collapse. MEBP station spread is now a setting (Machine configuration, 200-500mm) - it had been fixed at 300 in code since MEBP was written. After an in-app update the application comes back: the installer's launch entry is tied to the Finished page, which a silent update never shows. The status message no longer squeezes the tabs into unpressable scroll arrows - fixed-width box, elided, full text on hover. Includes 3.9.9: MEBP follows the parts rather than the bar end, and conveyor jog buttons work again.
